scope: Current Git-visible stage-e files, including nonignored new files; receipt itself follows its snapshot

manual_scope_review.figures: Both PNGs visually inspected; paired PDFs are produced by the same savefig loop. Categorical aggregate model scores and budget comparisons only, no per-origin price trajectory
manual_scope_review.long_ridge_arrays: Four exact learned Ridge export files only. Coefficients and training-prefix feature means/scales are our own learned/aggregate numerical artifacts, explicitly authorized; no raw row target arrays
manual_scope_review.channel_receipt: Only URL/time/error/status/hash/access-decision metadata. The2 raw HTML responses and request ledger remain private; no channel-price panel was obtained
manual_scope_review.publication_scope: Original and budget conclusions, all model summaries, fit histories and our numerical parameters are allowed. Third-party raw/canonical/NPZ/PT are not published

parameter_policy: Do not remove our trained numeric parameters merely because they are arrays or weights; raw sources and per-origin observations/predictions remain private

old_d_preservation.scope: Every delivered stage-d blob compared from current bytes; ignored bytecode/cache files are outside delivered content

limitations: Heuristic content checks plus explicit manual current-file review; not a universal detector of arbitrary transformed or encoded source data
Audit current exports again after the experiment; this snapshot cannot approve files created later
No market scoring, fitting, checkpoint loading or foreign-code execution in this audit
